papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
papers.abstract: Deep research requires agents to find answers that jointly satisfy multiple constraints. Discovering such answers is costly, whereas verifying a candidate can often be decomposed into tractable constraint-wise checks.

papers.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in K-12 education, but existing benchmarks mainly test exam question answering rather than understanding how curriculum knowledge is structured and visually presented.

papers.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. This work introduces a referring-then-tracking paradigm.

papers.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is promising as it removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), yet it still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student to ensure the self-teacher provides stronger learning signals.

papers.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence is essential for agents to move from static semantic understanding toward interacting with the physical world. Many spatial tasks are grounded in continuous visual scenes.

papers.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract: This work introduces SANA-Video 2.0, a hybrid video diffusion transformer designed to generate high-quality video up to 720p on a single GPU. It combines gated linear attention with periodic gated-softmax anchors.

papers.title: LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent
papers.abstract: As LLMs become more capable, they are increasingly deployed as collaborative agents. Yet genuine interaction is inherently dynamic: users rarely specify their intent upfront, instead disclosing, revising, and reshaping it.

papers.title: Color Pass-Through via Camera-Display Coupling
papers.abstract: When a real-world scene is captured by a smartphone camera and viewed on its screen, the displayed image often differs noticeably from the original scene in color, brightness, and contrast.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
papers.abstract: Understanding motion in video is a fundamental challenge for visual learning, as frame-to-frame change entangles two sources of dynamics: camera motion and object motion.

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
papers.abstract: This work studies on-policy distillation (OPD) for agentic tasks, where an LLM agent interacts with an environment over multiple turns and a student imitates a teacher over these multi-turn interaction histories.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

- Bug fixes and reliability improvements

What's changed

- Added Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok
- Added `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
- Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session
- Added `mcp_server_errors` to the headless stream-json init event, listing `--mcp-config` entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning

What's changed

- Changed `/code-review` to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target
- Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions in `--ax-screen-reader` mode
- Fixed Windows paths with `\u`-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs
